to-name: To the Reverend James Beck

Dear [Mr Beck](/person/132)
I hear that the Warden and the Echeverias have safely reached Otterbourne.[^2]
Thank you very much for them

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: This was the home of Mary Yonge after her father’s death in August 1877.
[^2]: The person most likely to be the one thanked here seems to be the Rev.

James Beck (b. 1819/20), Rector of Parham, Sussex, and subsequently of Bildeston, Suffolk, who had married (1867) Caroline Jeannette (Bignell) Walter, stepmother of Gertrude Walter.

The \'Warden\' was probably a pear tree.
